items.headline: U.S. Navy Deploys USS George Washington to Relieve Long-Deployed USS Abraham Lincoln
items.summary: The U.S. Navy has dispatched the aircraft carrier USS George Washington to the Middle East to relieve the USS Abraham Lincoln after an extended operational deployment. The carrier swap comes as officials address growing concerns from military families and lawmakers regarding supply shortages and crew morale following more than eight months at sea.

items.headline: James Webb Space Telescope Detects Water Near Milky Way's Supermassive Black Hole
items.summary: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have discovered water vapor and cosmic dust surrounding a star located just 0.55 light-years from Sagittarius A*, the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way [1.2.7]. The discovery challenges previous assumptions that intense radiation near black holes destroys water, offering new insight into how chemical building blocks survive in extreme galactic environments.

items.headline: Venus Williams Falls in Cincinnati Open First Round as Singles Streak Reaches 13 Losses
items.summary: Seven-time Grand Slam champion Venus Williams was defeated 6-2, 6-2 by Colombian qualifier Emiliana Arango in the first round of the Cincinnati Open on August 14 [1.3.2]. The result extends the 46-year-old tennis icon's singles losing streak to 13 matches as she competed at the WTA 1000 tournament via a wild-card entry.

items.headline: Phoebe Bridgers Releases 'Lost Weekend', Her First Solo Album in Six Years
items.summary: On August 14, 2026, indie rock singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers released her long-awaited third solo studio album, titled 'Lost Weekend'. The 16-track record is her first solo LP in six years and features notable collaborations with artists including Jack Antonoff, Lucy Dacus, and Julien Baker.
